translation.name: Kitapm kɛn Raa dɔɔko kiji ute jeege

book.name: Timote kɛn deete
book.title: Maktubm deet deet kɛn Pɔl raaŋin̰ Timote ki

content: Kɛse taar gɛn dɛjn̰ jee Raage
Debm gaab‑gɔɔlɔ se kɛn an̰ mooy num ɔn̰te kaacin̰ kaama, num gaŋ taaɗin̰ aan gɔɔ bubi mala. Ɔɔ gaangen gaabge se kic ɔkɗen jiga aan gɔɔ gɛnaaige mala.
Mɛndgen magalge se ɔkɗen jiga aan gɔɔ kɛn̰ige mala. Ɔɔ gaangen mɛndge se ɔkɗen jiga aan gɔɔ gɛnaaigen mala kici, naɓo ute maakŋ kalaŋ kɛn ɔk *kusin̰ eyo.
Kɛse taar gɛn dɛjn̰ jee Raage taa mɛnd‑daayge
Mɛnd‑daaygen ɔk nam aɗen noogŋ gɔtɔ se ɔkɗen ɔɔn̰ɔ.

Kɛn mɛnd‑daay gam jaay ɔk gaange lɔ ɔk ɓugge se, gaange se kꞋdooy roɗe gɛn kaakŋ do jeege tun maakŋ ɓeeɗege tu do bubɗege tu ute kɛn̰ɗege tu, ute naan̰ se jaay ɓo, taaɗn ɔɔ naaɗe ɔk taar *Raa se ɔɔn̰ɔ. Kɛse ɓo nakŋ kɛn tɔɔl Raa ki.
Mɛnd‑daay iŋg kalin̰ ki kɛn ɔk nam an̰ noogŋ gɔtɔ se, naan̰ se ɔnd don̰ do Raa ki. Daayum naan̰ eem Raa nɔɔrɔ katara ɔɔ sɛlin̰ mɛtin̰a taa an̰ noogo.
Num gaŋ mɛnd‑daay kɛn utu iŋg saap saap do nakge tun maakin̰ je sum se, naan̰ num utu iŋg zɛɛrɛ, naɓo ɗoobm Raa ki se aan gɔɔ debm ooyga kooyo.
Kɛse ɓo taargen naai an Ꞌdooy jeege taa mɛnd‑daayge se jꞋkɔŋ ne ɗim aak kus gɛn taaɗn roɗe ki eyo.

Debm jaay aak do taasin̰ge tu eyo ɔɔ aak do jeege tun maakŋ ɓeen̰ ki ey se, debm bin se rɛsŋga ute ɗoobm Isa *al‑Masi. Ɔɔ naan̰ se tɛɗga nakŋ *kusin̰ cir debm kɛn aal te maakin̰ do Isa al‑Masi ki ey ɓɔrtɔ.
Mɛnd‑daay jꞋan̰ raaŋ maakŋ mɛnd‑daayge tun jee Raage aɗen noog se, debm ɔk ɓaara si‑mɛcɛ jaayo ɔɔ iin̰ ɓo gaabin̰ kalaŋ sum.
Bɛɛki se, jeege paac an̰ jeele naan̰ se, mɛnd tɛɗn nakgen jiga, mɛnd ul gɛnin̰ge jiga, mɛnd ɔk mɛrtge, tug jɛ jee Raage
, noog jee daayge ɔɔ daayum naan̰ je ɗoobm tɛɗn bɛɛ.
Gaŋ mɛnd‑daaygen utu sɛɛm se, ɔn̰te raaŋ roɗe ute mɛnd‑daaygen jee Raage aɗe noog se, taa naaɗe se jaay roɗe baagga je gaabge se, naabm Isa al‑Masi se ɓon̰a aɗen tɔɔl eyo ɔɔ je ɗoobm Ꞌtɔkŋ gaabge.
Bin se naaɗe utu kɛnd maakŋ kusin̰ ki taa dɔɔkŋ maakɗen deet deet gɛn tɛɗn naabm Isa al‑Masi se lɛ, naaɗe rɛsŋga naatn.

Kɛn mꞋɔɔ jꞋɔn̰te raaŋɗen se taa kɛn kꞋraaŋɗenga num, naaɗe tɛɗn mɛnd kaar‑naabge ɔɔ lee kuun do ɓee jeege. Num gɛn kaar‑naabɗege sum eyo, gaŋ naaɗe tɛɗn mɛnd kɔɔɗn jeege, tɔɔl taarɗege maakŋ taar jeege tu ɔɔ taargen gɛn taaɗ ey kic ɓo, naaɗe an̰ taaɗa.
Taa naan̰ se ɓo mꞋje mɛnd‑daaygen sɛɛm se, kꞋtɔk gaabge ɔɔ kꞋjꞋooj gaange, kꞋjꞋɔk ɓeeɗege tɔɔgɔ. Bin se jee taamooyjege se Ꞌkɔŋ taar ɗim kusin̰ rojege tu eyo.
Kɛn ɔlum taaɗ bin se, taa kɛngen mɛtin̰ge se rɛs ɔn̰ga ɗoobm Raa se naatn. Naaɗe uunga ɗoobm *Ɓubm sitange.

Mɛnd aalga maakin̰ do Isa al‑Masi ki jaay ɔk mɛnd‑daay gam maakŋ taasin̰ge tu num, n̰Ꞌaakin̰ don̰ ki. Ɔn̰te kɔn̰ *egliz ɓo an̰ kaakŋ don̰ ki, bin se egliz se Ꞌkaakŋ do mɛnd‑daayge tun kɛn ɔk nam aɗen noogŋ gɔtɔ.
Kɛse taar gɛn dɛjn̰ jee naan jee egliz ki

Jee naan jee *eglizge tu kɛn jaay tɛɗ naabɗe aak jiga maakŋ egliz ki se, jee se jꞋaalɗen maak ki ɔɔ jꞋɔkɗen ɔɔn̰ɔ. Tap ki num jee kɛn lee taaɗ taar Raa jeege tu ɔɔ dooy jeege ute taar Raa se naaɗe se ɓo jꞋɔkɗen ɔɔn̰ cir paac paac.
Taa Kitap ɗeek ɔɔ: Maraŋ tiiko nakŋ tɔnd gɛmɛ se, jꞋɔn̰te kɔlin̰ ɗim taarin̰ ki kɛn an̰ gaasn kɔsɔ.
Ɔɔ tɛr gɔt kuuy taar Raa taaɗ ɔɔ: Debm tɛɗn naaba se kꞋjꞋɔgin̰ gɔtɔŋgin̰a.
Kɛn nam jaay ɔk mind debm maakŋ naan jeege tun egliz ki se, kɛn jeege dio lɔ mɔtɔ jaay saaɗin̰ ey se, ɔn̰te Ꞌkuun taarin̰a.
Jee naan jee Raage tun tɛɗ *kusin̰ se Ꞌmooyɗen naan jeege tu paac, bin jaay jee kuuy aakga kic, num Ꞌɓeere.
Maam mꞋtɔnd mɛti naan Raa ki, naan Isa *al‑Masi ki ɔɔ naan *kɔɗn Raage tun naan̰ bɛɛr tɔɔɗɗeno se, uun taar kɛn maam mꞋtaaɗi se, ɔn̰te ɓaa mɛtn nam ki ɔɔ ɔn̰te kooc mɛtn nam.
Ɔn̰te Ꞌnaar gɛn kɔnd ji do nam ki ɔɔ ɔn̰te Ꞌkɔl doi maakŋ kusin̰ nam ki. Naai mala Ꞌbɔɔb roi bɛɛ naan Raa ki.
Ɔn̰te Ꞌkaay maane kalin̰ ki sum, num taa maaki lee ɔɔn̰i se aay tɔtn koojn̰ bin̰ cɔkɔ, taa ai tɔɔlɔ.
Kusin̰ jee mɛtin̰ge se kɛn jꞋɔndɗen te bɔɔr ey kic ɓo tooɗ tal, gaŋ gɛn jee mɛtin̰ge se jꞋɔndɗenga bɔɔrɔ jaay mɛtin̰ teece.
Bin se nakgen jigan kɛn jeege lee tɛɗ se kic ɓo tooɗn tal, anum gɛn jee mɛtin̰gen tɛɗ nakŋ jiga kɛn jꞋɔŋ jꞋaakɗen ey se kic ɓo utu Ꞌtooɗn tal.

footnotes.text: Tug jɛ jee Raage se je ɗeekŋ ɔɔ: debm dɔɔɗ ɔk mɛrtge jiga. Kɛse ɓo nakŋ kɛn Yaudge lee tɛɗa kɛn mɛrtge aanga gɔtɗe ki.
